questions.cardText:
[Zoology] What part of its body does a wombat use for defense?
A. Its tongue
B. Its jaws
C. Its rear end
Answer: C. When threatened, a wombat dives into a burrow and uses its tough, cartilage-reinforced backside to block the entrance. This toughened rear can withstand bites and blows, protecting the wombat from predators.
questions.de: Welchen Körperteil setzt ein Wombat zur Verteidigung ein, wenn er sich in seinen Bau flüchtet?
questions.en: What part of its body does a wombat use for defense when it dives into its burrow?

timeline.labelEn: George Shaw first describes the common wombat scientifically
timeline.labelDe: George Shaw beschreibt den Nacktnasenwombat erstmals wissenschaftlich

questions.notes: Wikipedia: their primary defence is their toughened rear hide, most of the posterior made of cartilage; they block the tunnel with their rumps.

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] Which of the following weather phenomena may occur as a result of a volcanic eruption?
A. Tornado B. Lightning C. Hail
Answer: B. During a volcanic eruption, ash and particles collide, which can create static electricity that eventually leads to volcanic lightning.
questions.de: Welche Wettererscheinung kann in der Aschewolke eines Vulkanausbruchs entstehen, wenn zusammenstoßende Aschepartikel statische Elektrizität aufbauen?
questions.en: What weather phenomenon can form in the plume of a volcanic eruption when colliding ash particles build up static electricity?

timeline.labelEn: Pliny the Younger describes lightning in the eruption of Mount Vesuvius, the earliest recorded volcanic lightning
timeline.labelDe: Plinius der Jüngere beschreibt Blitze beim Ausbruch des Vesuvs – die früheste überlieferte Beobachtung von Vulkanblitzen
